name: Band Pull Apart
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at chest height, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Keep your arms nearly straight and your ribs down.
Pause when the band touches your chest or you reach full range.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A simple resistance-band exercise for the rear shoulders and upper back that counters the forward-hunched posture of desk work.
